text:
Maria Chen: FYI noticed a weird recurring small charge in multiple project invoices — labeled 'Accelerator micro-adjustment' for ~0.03-0.12 USD lines across zones. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/invoices?project=redwood-prod (can't paste invoice IDs here)

Kevin Patel: hmm can you screenshot the line? seems like a rounding/aggregation thing but across zones sounds off :thinking_face:

Maria Chen: screenshot pasted in the thread (private). It's on the billing export too — I ran a quick BigQuery look and see ~1200 small lines in Feb across projects redwood-prod, redwood-ml, and redwood-platform.

Samir Rao: do we have commitment splits across those projects? if a single commitment is split by subaccount or family, GCP can apply small per-second reconciliations when instances move between zones

Maria Chen: we do have a shared Committed Use Discount for A100s scoped to the org, but last week finance asked to split consumption reporting by project so someone may have changed how we linked the commitment.

infra-bot: Billing export anomaly detector: "spike in low-value accelerator lineitems" triggered at 1990012360. Count=1,128; distinct SKUs=3; suggested tag: billing-export:investigate

Kevin Patel: can you run this BigQuery to confirm the pattern?

Kevin Patel: ```
SELECT invoice_month, project_id, sku_description, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_billing_export_v1.gcp_billing_export_*`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%Accelerator%' AND invoice_month = '2026-02'
GROUP BY invoice_month, project_id, sku_description
ORDER BY lines DESC
``` 

Maria Chen: running now — returning same cluster of tiny charges, mostly in us-west1/asia-east1 and tied to preemptible A100s.

Samir Rao: preemptible churn + per-second billing rounding can create many tiny leftover adjustments when preemptions reassign capacity across committed pools. But the amounts you quoted feel larger than pure rounding. Did we get an unexpected rate change or new surcharge?

Ava (Finance): No rate change on our contract that I'm aware of. I checked committed-use SKUs and the list price is stable. Could be billing system reclassification. We should open GCP support and ask for a CSV of raw usage vs invoice aggregation.

Kevin Patel: good call. Maria — can you export the raw usage rows for a couple of sample days and attach? I'll triage and maybe open ticket under our reseller rep if needed.

Maria Chen: attached sample export for 2026-02-12 and 2026-02-13. Rows show repeated small "micro-adjustment" entries with usage_start_time differing by seconds.

Samir Rao: I suspect a bug where ephemeral vCPU/KV-cache allocations trigger small accelerator rounding credits when a request is routed to a different machine family. I'll open a ticket: GCP case #CASE-2026-7142 with logs attached. tag: @gcp-account-team

Ava (Finance): please CC billing@redwood.com and include invoice IDs — we need to reconcile for accounting. If GCP won't issue credits, we'll need to file for manual adjustment.

Kevin Patel: action items:
- Samir: keep GCP ticket and push for CSV of raw usage vs invoice lines (assigned)
- Maria: run a grouped BigQuery per-sku/per-project for Feb (assigned)
- Ava: prepare accounting hold note in our ledger in case credits pending (assigned)

Maria Chen: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Auto-reminder set: follow up in 3d on GCP case CASE-2026-7142.
